parameters.title: The row's words.
parameters.subtitle: A supporting line.
parameters.trailing: A control at its end (a switch, a checkbox).
parameters.trailingText: A value at its end, printed on the row (a time, a count, a status such as "Just now"): read, not pressed.
parameters.onTap: Called when the row is pressed; null for a row that is only read.
parameters.selected: Whether the row is the chosen one (the note open beside the list).
parameters.showChevron: Whether a chevron says the row opens something; by onTap when null.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader says for the row, when its words are not enough.
